product: GitLab Duo Agent Platform + Google Cloud Vertex AI
source_title: GitLab Collaborates with Google Cloud to Bring Agentic DevSecOps to Enterprise Teams Using Vertex AI
claim_summary: Company says Duo Agent Platform agents can now call Vertex AI models including Gemini under GitLab access controls and audit logging; usage can count toward Google Cloud commitments; AI Gateway can run on GKE or Cloud Run
availability: vendor says available now; release stage tiers regions and pricing unstated
limitation: Press release only; no GA/preview label; governance claim not independently exercised

source_title: A guide to the breaking changes in GitLab 19.0
claim_summary: Vendor lists 17 breaking changes for 19.0 (4 high 5 medium 8 low) including ROPC OAuth grant removal PostgreSQL 17 minimum and removal of bundled Helm chart PostgreSQL Redis MinIO; GitLab.com deployment windows May 4-6 with May 11-13 fallback
availability: advance notice; removals later shipped in 19.0
limitation: English page metadata says Apr 15 and last updated Jun 24; French-language copy displays Apr 24; intro projected 15 changes vs 17 listed; maintenance cost to self-managed users not measured

source_title: GitLab 18.11 released with Vulnerability resolution generally available on GitLab Duo Agent Platform
claim_summary: Release notes list agentic vulnerability resolution GA (Ultimate); Data Analyst agent GA; CI Expert agent beta; fine-grained PAT permissions beta; service accounts on Free; Mistral self-hosted model support; default Agentic Chat model changed
feature: agentic security remediation and CI agents
availability: mix of GA and beta per heading; tier and offering vary
limitation: Many headings carry no status label; generated fixes and merge requests not independently evaluated; press release dateline shows Apr 14 while list/URL date is Apr 16

product: GitLab Duo Agent Platform + Anthropic Claude

availability: reported company financials; guidance is forward-looking

source_title: GitLab Reports First Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results (Subsequent Event)

availability: announced plan; execution over following quarters
limitation: Impact on product maintenance support or open-source contribution not measured; TNW reports management intends to reinvest savings in R&D and AI

product: Next Generation SCM; GitLab Orbit; Governance for Agents; GitLab Flex

availability: private beta / public beta / order intake; no GA dates

availability: survey findings only
